title: AI Finance: what we do
name: Tal Wallenstein, CPA
cta: Great to have you with us!

segments.text: Hi, I'm Tal Wallenstein. CPA, certified board director, and Big Four alumna.

segments.label: Tal & Roei
segments.text: With my brother Roei, I co-founded AI Finance.
We help finance teams bring AI into their daily work: lectures, workshops, and hands-on guidance.

segments.label: Lectures
segments.text: Lectures for executives and finance leaders: what AI can already do in finance, what AI agents mean for managers, how to choose tools and controls, and where to start.

segments.label: Workshops
segments.text: Hands-on workshops for finance teams, FP&A, accounting and payroll. We practice on real tasks, with the tools your company has approved, and we check every output.

segments.label: Process guidance
segments.text: Process guidance: we map your recurring tasks, choose one process, and build a measurable pilot before you scale.

segments.label: Tailored to you
segments.text: Everything is tailored to your organization, whether you work with ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Gemini, and done together with your information security team.

segments.label: Courses
segments.text: And for individuals, open courses with the National Center for Director Training.

segments.label: Human in the loop
segments.text: Our motto today is human in the loop. Not a machine that replaces people, but one that pushes people to move forward together with AI, and build a new, richer world of content.
The future of AI starts with people.
This is exactly where you come in.

segments.label: With a smile
segments.text: And all of it with a smile.
So nice to meet you, and great to have you with us.
